|lore=Chewie honored his life debt to Han by protecting Leia. Posed as the mercenary Snoova while on Coruscant. '''Smuggler'''. Wookiee.
|game_text=Deploys free to Coruscant and is a spy there. While with Leia (or at a related site), her game text may not be canceled, and, once per turn, you may take the bottom card of your Force Pile into hand. During your deploy phase, you may ▼ Boushh or a Vibro-Ax on him.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Chewbacca, Protector (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 1, slip 1 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “Deploys free to Coruscant and is a spy there. While with Leia (or at a related site), her game text may not be canceled, and, once per turn, you may take the bottom card of your Force Pile into hand. During your deploy phase, you may ▼ Boushh or a Vibro-Ax on him.” Stats line: “POWER 6 ABILITY 2 ARMOR 4”. Deploy 3, forfeit 7. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•1” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf], Internet Archive 5 December 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS7-01-Chewbacca_Protector-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Chewbacca, Protector (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 1), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploys free to Coruscant and is a spy while there. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Boushh or Vibro-Ax (on Chewie) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While with Leia, her game text may not be canceled and, once per turn, may take the bottom card of Force Pile into hand.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
